en:
Hey, Shuichi. Others gather at dining hall,
right?

Gonta think about going...but Kokichi say he
wanna have strategy meeting with Gonta...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Gonta for a while?

Hm? You want Gonta, Shuichi? I don't mind,
so go ahead and take him off my hands, okay?

D-Don't talk like that!
G-Gonta not property!

So...what should we do?
You can pick, Shuichi.
<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta and I grew a little closer today.
